metadata.name: guard
metadata.description: Guardrail: limits your AI trading agent cannot break, as the delegate of a Velocity perps account.

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: G9: the agent may always cancel an order the guard placed, even while paused. It may not cancel the owner's
own orders or cancel everything (None); such a request is a recorded refusal.

instructions.name: checkpoint
docs: G10, permissionless: anyone can take the day's baseline with fresh prices (the max rule). The keeper the owner
named, in the first hour of the UTC day, marks the day at the equity then (yesterday's losses stay yesterday's);
the owner resets the baseline to the equity now at any time. Every checkpoint emits a Checkpointed event.

instructions.name: close_guard
docs: Owner only: closes the guard (any layout) and returns its rent to the owner. The owner removes the guard as the
Velocity account's delegate separately (Velocity's update_user_delegate); init_guard can then run again.

instructions.name: init_guard
docs: The Velocity user's authority creates the guard with an agent and limits. Afterwards the owner sets the guard
PDA as the user's delegate with Velocity's own update_user_delegate.

instructions.name: migrate_guard
docs: Owner only: grows a guard made under an older append-only layout (865, 950, 967 or 999 bytes) to the current size. Fields are only ever
appended, so the old bytes keep their meaning and the new ones start at zero (G10 off unless it was set, no last
equity seen, no keeper). The owner pays the extra rent.

instructions.name: place_perp_order
docs: The agent's only way to trade. Remaining accounts are Velocity's account maps (oracles, then spot markets,
then perp markets); the guard reads the ones it needs and forwards all of them.

instructions.name: set_agent
docs: G7: owner only. Pubkey::default() revokes the agent.

instructions.name: set_daily_loss
docs: G10, owner only: the most equity (quote units) the account may lose in one UTC day before risk-increasing
orders are refused. 0 turns the brake off.

instructions.name: set_keeper
docs: G10, owner only: the keeper whose first-hour checkpoint marks the day at midnight (Pubkey::default() = none).

instructions.name: set_limits
docs: G7: owner only.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: G7: owner only. While paused, only cancels and exits (G9) go through.

errors.name: OrderTooLarge

errors.name: MarketNotAllowed
errors.msg: G2: market is not on the owner's allowlist

errors.name: OrderTypeNotAllowed
errors.msg: G2: order type is not allowed

errors.name: BuilderFieldsRefused
errors.msg: G2: builder fields must be empty

errors.name: DailyNotionalExceeded
errors.msg: G3: daily notional cap would be exceeded

errors.name: ExposureExceeded
errors.msg: G4: worst-case exposure on this market would exceed the cap

errors.name: LeverageExceeded
errors.msg: G5: worst-case leverage would exceed the cap

errors.name: PriceOutsideBand
errors.msg: G6: price is outside the band around the oracle

errors.name: StaleOracle
errors.msg: G6: oracle is stale

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: G7: guard is paused

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.msg: G7: signer is not the owner

errors.name: NotAgent
errors.msg: signer is not this guard's agent

errors.name: AgentRevoked
errors.msg: the agent has been revoked

errors.name: NotPerp
errors.msg: only perp orders are allowed

errors.name: BitFlagsRefused
errors.msg: order bit flags must be zero

errors.name: TriggerOrdersRefused
errors.msg: trigger orders are not supported

errors.name: ZeroSize
errors.msg: order size must be greater than zero

errors.name: NotVelocityUser
errors.msg: account is not a Velocity user

errors.name: NotUserAuthority
errors.msg: signer is not the Velocity user's authority

errors.name: BadMarketAccount
errors.msg: a Velocity market account is invalid

errors.name: MissingMarketAccount
errors.msg: a needed Velocity market or oracle account is missing

errors.name: UnsupportedOracle
errors.msg: the market's oracle source is not supported

errors.name: OtherSpotBalance
errors.msg: only a positive quote balance is supported: another spot balance or a quote borrow exists

errors.name: BadOracleAccount
errors.msg: oracle account is invalid

errors.name: NonPositiveEquity
errors.msg: account equity is not positive

errors.name: InvalidLimits
errors.msg: limits are invalid

errors.name: PostTradeCheckFailed
errors.msg: post-trade check failed

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: StaleExitUnfavourable
errors.msg: G9: with a very stale oracle an exit must be priced on the owner-favourable side of the last oracle price

errors.name: CancelNotAllowed
errors.msg: the agent may cancel only orders the guard placed, by id

errors.name: OrderLifetimeTooLong
errors.msg: the order's max_ts is not in the future or is later than the owner's order lifetime allows

errors.name: TooManyOpenOrders
errors.msg: 32 orders the guard placed are already open; cancel one first

errors.name: DailyLossExceeded
errors.msg: G10: today's loss is over the owner's daily loss cap; only exits and cancels pass until the next UTC day

errors.name: OrderNotStored
errors.msg: Velocity stored no order for this call

errors.name: ReduceOnlyBeyondPosition
errors.msg: a reduce-only order must oppose the position and, with the guard's resting exits, fit inside it

errors.name: KeeperRequired
errors.msg: G10: name a keeper (set_keeper) before setting a daily loss cap

errors.name: BadGuardAccount
errors.msg: not a guard account of this program for this owner

errors.name: KeeperIsAgent
errors.msg: the keeper and the agent must be different keys

types.name: Checkpointed
docs: Emitted for every cancel the agent asks for.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 the max rule, 1 the keeper's midnight mark, 2 the owner's reset.

fields.name: agent
docs: Pubkey::default() when revoked.

fields.name: day
docs: UTC day number (unix / 86400) that day_notional belongs to.

fields.name: accepted_count
docs: Orders accepted (G9 exits included).

fields.name: refused_g1
docs: Orders refused, by rule (G2 includes order-shape refusals; G5 includes non-positive equity and unsupported
spot balances; G7 is the pause).

fields.name: placed_order_ids
docs: Order ids the guard placed that are still open (0 = free slot). The agent may cancel only these.

fields.name: placed_cursor
docs: Unused since ids go into free slots; kept so the account layout does not change.

fields.name: last_refusal_by_rule
docs: The last refusal for each rule (index = rule code, 0..=7), so a later refusal cannot bury an earlier one.

fields.name: max_daily_loss
docs: G10 (appended so earlier fields keep their offsets): the owner's daily loss cap in quote units (0 = off),
the UTC day of the baseline, the baseline equity and Velocity's net deposits at that moment.

fields.name: last_seen_equity
docs: The last equity the guard saw on any call, Velocity's net deposits then, and whether it has seen one: a new
day's baseline is never below it (audit round 2, N2). loss_day == today means the day's baseline is set.

fields.name: keeper
docs: The owner's keeper: its checkpoint in the first hour of a UTC day marks the day at midnight (default: none).

fields.name: last_seen_day
docs: The UTC day of last_seen_equity.

fields.name: day_high_equity
docs: The highest equity known for day_high_day (from that day's baseline and every reading), and the net deposits
then; a new day's baseline without a midnight mark is never below it. Taken from the reserved bytes.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for future fields, so they need no migration (zero now).

fields.name: reason
docs: The GuardError code (6000 + variant).

fields.name: max_order_base
docs: G1: largest base amount per order.

fields.name: markets
docs: G2 allowlist and G4 caps.

fields.name: allowed_order_types
docs: G2: bitmask of allowed order types (1 << tag). Only Market, Limit and Oracle may be set.

fields.name: daily_notional_cap
docs: G3: total order notional per UTC day, in quote units (1e6 = 1 dUSDT).

fields.name: max_leverage_bps
docs: G5: worst-case notional over equity, in basis points (10_000 = 1x).

fields.name: price_band_bps
docs: G6: prices must be within this many basis points of the oracle.

fields.name: max_oracle_staleness_slots
docs: G6: the oracle must have been posted within this many slots.

fields.name: exit_max_staleness_slots
docs: G9: exits with an oracle older than this may only be priced on the owner-favourable side of the last oracle
price (sell at or above it, buy at or below it). Must be at least max_oracle_staleness_slots.

fields.name: max_order_lifetime_secs
docs: Non-exit orders must carry max_ts no later than now + this many seconds (0: no bound).

fields.name: market_index
docs: Velocity perp market index.

fields.name: max_exposure_base
docs: G4 cap on worst-case exposure in base units (1e9 = 1 SOL). Zero means the row is unused.

types.name: OrderChecked
docs: Emitted for every order the agent sends, accepted or refused (a refused transaction keeps its logs).

fields.name: rule
docs: One of `rule::*`.

fields.name: value
docs: The measured value for the rule (size, notional, exposure, leverage bps, band bps, slots).

fields.name: cap
docs: The owner's cap for the rule.

fields.name: reason
docs: The GuardError code naming the refusal (0 when accepted).

types.name: OrderParams
docs: Mirror of Velocity's OrderParams (borsh layout from its IDL). Enums are kept as their u8 tags.
